implementation_rules: ReferenceDrawList is an internal permanent direct/reference oracle and explicitly not the final optimized FrameGraph ABI.

DirectReferenceSource must validate FrameState.sceneGeneration, FrameState.sceneReadToken, VisibilityResult.sceneGeneration, VisibilityResult.sceneReadToken, and RuntimeScene.generation before plan construction.
The production loop must be driven only by VisibilityResult.backToFront and use RuntimeScene.find once for each visible ID; it must not iterate RuntimeScene.records() or any semantic store.
Every visible ID must produce an ordered traversal entry; missing records are an error, never a silent skip.
Shape, Image, VectorPath, RichText, VectorStroke, DabStroke, Connector, and Sticky produce typed renderer-neutral pixel commands; Group produces an explicit ordered zero-pixel traversal entry.

Each traversal entry preserves object ID, ObjectKind, kind version, placement/order, transform, properties, content, erase masks, geometry/visual/world bounds, reference-geometry digest, and direct dependencies required by the permanent oracle.

Plan metadata preserves view/camera/viewport/metrics, scene/read, surface/metrics, and frame identities exactly and includes an explicit renderer-neutral world-to-view affine mapping derived from CameraState and logical metrics; G3-03 does not invent backend or platform-surface transforms.
Canonical serialization is versioned, byte-order explicit, deterministic for every scalar/variant/vector/string, and covers the complete ReferenceDrawList; exact structure remains the primary oracle.
No optional transient selection/editor input is introduced by this package.
